scope: Six complete independent trainer website directions with pricing and joining previews
ownerFeedback: The first three are moving in the right direction; add signup, pricing and more versions.

publication.provenance: Exact checked source pushed and packaged; native saved source matched. Private identifiers retained outside this public repository.

motion-studies-static.json.scope: Generated HTML, local references, distinct recipe structure, data completeness, asset budgets and arithmetic layout constraints; not browser rendering or measured performance.
motion-studies-static.json.browser: not run; no local Browser tool and standing no-cloud-browser rule

site-commerce.json.scope: DOM state/events with linkedom, independent expected price totals, selected-offer continuity, back/edit, errors, safe text, close/reset, member preview, preferences, schedule filters, reduced motion and storage failure. No real accounts/payments or native browser layout/focus/performance.

motion-studies-interactions.json.scope: DOM state with linkedom 0.18.12 and animation engine unavailable: tabs, keyboard, busy-week data, dialogs, form demo, reduced motion, storage failure. Not native focus, rendered browser playback or measured frame pacing.

motion-studies-timelines.json.scope: Actual timeline/easing calculations with plain-property targets and synthetic viewport dimensions. Forward/reverse/stopped progress and settled states. Not CSS rendering, ScrollTrigger geometry, interaction latency or frame pacing.

motion-studies-css.json.scope: CSS and selector syntax plus twenty-five representative solid text/background pairs. Not rendered layout, whole-page WCAG qualification or photograph-overlay contrast. Unsupported browser pseudo-elements adapted only for selector parsing.

site-commerce-type.json.scope: Pillow original-font advance estimates with CSS tracking for selected phone headline lines. Not browser text shaping, line wrapping or rendered layout.

notVerified: Owner acceptance of expanded six-site build
